technique_roles: transparent watercolor wash and material handling
cool blue and lavender value grouping
selective dark anchors that preserve open paper

positive_prompt: Transparent watercolor washes with restrained cool blue and lavender value groups; soft blooms and graded transitions balanced by a few controlled edges; selective dark anchors; generous unpainted paper; translate only the photographed subject through the reference's material handling.
negative_prompt: Do not copy the reference seascape, shoreline, water horizon, landscape, or composition. No invented water, photographic background, opaque gouache mass, oil-paint impasto, hard digital vector edge, generated text, decorative frame, route line, marker, watermark, collage seam, or rectangular plate edge.

edges.subject: soft wash transitions with selective controlled anchors

finishing_notes: use the reference only for watercolor behavior, edge control, value grouping, and dark-anchor placement
keep pale washes translucent and avoid a full-field tint
derive no seascape, water, shoreline, horizon, or landscape content from the reference

mark_edge_quality: transparent wash blooms and graded watercolor transitions
soft edges balanced by a few controlled dark anchors
negative_space_rules: preserve generous unpainted paper around and within the subject
do not turn the reference's open water or sky into subject matter
fill_tonal_rules: group values in restrained cool blue and lavender washes
use selective dark accents rather than continuous heavy outlines
background_cleanliness: empty areas match the shared paper master
no watercolor haze, rectangular backing patch, or random speckle field
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid generated frames, borders, crop edges, and plate seams
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: selective watercolor simplification that preserves the source photo's identity and imports no reference subject
